name: Cthulhu — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Cthulhu from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Great Old One, Cthulhu" but are not part of the Cthulhu entry, which is unchanged.

Overwhelming (Ex)

Cthulhu’s damage reduction, resistances, and immunities cannot be bypassed or suppressed by any means.

Likewise, mind-affecting effects Cthulhu creates bypass all forms of immunity except that of mindless creatures, though creatures normally immune gain a +4 circumstance bonus on saving throws to resist mind-affecting effects.

Tentacles (Ex)

Cthulhu’s tentacles are a primary Attack.

Unspeakable Presence (Su)
